subject: Important Update: New Payment Method Available
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to inform you that we have introduced a new payment method for your convenience. You can now pay for your orders using our secure online portal, making transactions faster and easier than ever before. Simply log in to your account and select the new payment option at checkout. If you have any questions or need assistance, please don't hesitate to contact our customer support team. Thank you for choosing our services. Best regards, The Payment Team
